raw and demo C ABI for both AIRs

native_initialization: GPU C ABI routing requires the existing Rust-side resident research initialization in the same process. No exported native GPU lifecycle API is added in this checkpoint.
regressions: Candidate wallets, cubic/quadratic PCS, quotient, generalized FRI, recursive sessions, worker admission and completion checks retained.
pilot_notes: Initial private-module placement and test metadata access errors were corrected before successful debug pilots.
Pilot 01 verified 16 Rust proofs before ABI integration; pilot 02 verified eight ABI proofs before final logging cleanup.

The wide validator initially rejected expected CPU serialization and checked obsolete storage option names. The original successful proof log was revalidated without native re-execution; validator-revision-01.json preserves the original record.

The copied original prior runner lacked its later corrected hiding-PCS log label. That known validator correction was restored and the successful log revalidated without native re-execution; validator-revision-02.json and its original runner are preserved.
Final qualification uses one matching archive of 443 current source inputs across all three build profiles.
limitations: Legacy batch proving and private-wallet worker admission remain unfinished; batches retain existing CPU admission.
Quadratic lookup generation, owned multi-AIR commitments and full-size recursive workloads remain open.
GPU routing requires the explicit complete GPU selection; default CPU behavior is preserved.
Standalone native clients still need a GPU initialization/lifecycle API; C ABI qualification here follows existing Rust-side initialization.
Debug complete-STARK checks retain explicit CPU constraint audits and reject strict GPU-required admission.
Correctness fixtures do not establish sustained transaction throughput or resource calibration.
AMD/Metal qualification and the pending authorized local Mac source checkpoint remain outstanding; no SSH retrieval was attempted.
